answer_1.quote: To evaluate the reasoning capabilities of LLMs when presented with transient information in tables, we created a question-answering dataset in which answers cannot be derived from a single table alone.
answer_1.outputs: Concise answers (5-10 words) to questions about temporally evolving tables

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics: We employed several metrics to compare the results across different models: F1 score, Exact Match (EM), Rouge-1 (R1), and Rouge-L (RL).

answer_4.quote: In addition, human evaluations were carried out, revealing a significant performance gap that LLMs must address.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluations were conducted to benchmark performance and analyze shortcomings.
